answer: Reputation Ledge Lock. Each agent’s first N transactions are held in escrow until distinct counterparties confirm delivery; the agent cannot wander to fresh identities because confirmations attach to a persistent work history. A clone must fund N escrowed jobs plus wait out settlement, and any abandoned history forfeits the ledge. Attacker cost per identity is the full escrow float, not a token fee, making clones strictly negative-EV across the canyon of repeat attempts.
